Q1.reference_answer: A data structure that stores elements following the first in first out principle. The main operations in a queue are enqueue and dequeue.

Q2.question_text: How many steps does it take to search a node in a binary search tree?

Q4.question_text: What is the main difference between strings declared using the type string versus strings declared using an array of characters?
Q4.reference_answer: The strings declared using an array of characters have a null element added at the end of the array.
